- Explore: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use it to find files by pattern (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), grep for symbols or keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y." Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).

- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

62	// NewSSEHub creates a new SSE hub.

69	// Subscribe registers a new client and returns it.

71	func (h *SSEHub) Subscribe(userID int32, role store.Role) *SSEClient {
72		c := &SSEClient{
73			// Buffer a few events so a slow client doesn't block broadcasting.
74			events: make(chan []byte, 32),
75			userID: userID,
76			role:   role,
77		}
78		h.mu.Lock()
79		if h.closed {
80			close(c.events)
81		} else {
82			h.clients[c] = struct{}{}
83		}
84		h.mu.Unlock()
85		return c

89	func (h *SSEHub) Unsubscribe(c *SSEClient) {
90		h.mu.Lock()
91		if _, ok := h.clients[c]; ok {
92			delete(h.clients, c)
93			close(c.events)

98	// Close disconnects all subscribed SSE clients.

44	func NewServer(ctx context.Context, profile *profile.Profile, store *store.Store) (*Server, error) {
45		s := &Server{
46			Store:   store,
47			Profile: profile,
48		}
49	
50		echoServer := echo.New()
51		echoServer.Use(middleware.Recover())
52		echoServer.Use(newCORSMiddleware(profile))
53		s.echoServer = echoServer
54	
55		instanceBasicSetting, err := s.getOrUpsertInstanceBasicSetting(ctx)
56		if err != nil {
57			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get instance basic setting")
58		}
59	
60		secret := "usememos"
61		if !profile.Demo {
62			secret = instanceBasicSetting.SecretKey
63		}
64		s.Secret = secret
65	
66		// Register healthz endpoint.
67		echoServer.GET("/healthz", func(c *echo.Context) error {
68			return c.String(http.StatusOK, "Service ready.")
69		})
70	
71		// Serve frontend static files.
72		frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)
73	
74		rootGroup := echoServer.Group("")
75	
76		apiV1Service := apiv1.NewAPIV1Service(s.Secret, profile, store)
77		s.sseHub = apiV1Service.SSEHub
78	
79		// Register HTTP file server routes BEFORE gRPC-Gateway to ensure proper range request handling for Safari.
80		// This uses native HTTP serving (http.ServeContent) instead of gRPC for video/audio files.
81		fileServerService := fileserver.NewFileServerService(s.Profile, s.Store, s.Secret)
82		fileServerService.RegisterRoutes(echoServer)
83	
84		// Create and register RSS routes (needs markdown service from apiV1Service).
85		rss.NewRSSService(s.Profile, s.Store, apiV1Service.MarkdownService).RegisterRoutes(rootGroup)
86	
87		// Register gRPC gateway as api v1 (includes SSE endpoint on CORS-enabled group).
88		if err := apiV1Service.RegisterGateway(ctx, echoServer); err != nil {
89			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to register gRPC gateway")
90		}
91	
92		mcpService, err := mcp.NewMCPService(profile, echoServer)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create MCP service")
95		}
96		mcpService.RegisterRoutes(echoServer)
97	
98		return s, nil
99	}

101	func (s *Server) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
102		var address, network string
103		if len(s.Profile.UNIXSock) == 0 {
104			address = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", s.Profile.Addr, s.Profile.Port)
105			network = "tcp"
106		} else {
107			address = s.Profile.UNIXSock
108			network = "unix"
109		}
110		listener, err := net.Listen(network, address)
111		if err != nil {
112			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to listen")
113		}
114	
115		if network == "unix" {
116			if err := os.Chmod(address, 0660); err != nil {
117				_ = listener.Close()
118				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to chmod socket")
119			}
120		}
121	
122		// Start Echo server directly (no cmux needed - all traffic is HTTP).
123		s.httpServer = &http.Server{Handler: s.echoServer}
124		go func() {
125			if err := s.httpServer.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
126				slog.Error("failed to start echo server", "error", err)
127			}
128		}()
129		s.startBackgroundRunners(ctx)
130	
131		return nil
132	}

153	func (s *Server) startBackgroundRunners(ctx context.Context) {
154		// Create a separate context for each background runner
155		// This allows us to control cancellation for each runner independently
156		s3Context, s3Cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
157	
158		// Store the cancel function so we can properly shut down runners
159		s.backgroundRunnerCancels = append(s.backgroundRunnerCancels, s3Cancel)
160	
161		// Create and start S3 presign runner
162		s3presignRunner := s3presign.NewRunner(s.Store)
163		s3presignRunner.RunOnce(ctx)
164	
165		// Start continuous S3 presign runner
166		s.backgroundRunnerWG.Add(1)
167		go func() {
168			defer s.backgroundRunnerWG.Done()
169			s3presignRunner.Run(s3Context)
170			slog.Info("s3presign runner stopped")
171		}()
172	
173		slog.Info("background runners started")
174	}

176	func (s *Server) stopBackgroundRunners() {
177		for _, cancelFunc := range s.backgroundRunnerCancels {
178			if cancelFunc != nil {

181		}
182	}

185		done := make(chan struct{})
186		go func() {

188			close(done)
189		}()
190	
191		select {
192		case <-done:
193		case <-ctx.Done():
194			select {
195			case <-done:
196				return
197			default:
198			}
199			slog.Error("failed to stop background runners", slog.String("error", ctx.Err().Error()))
200		}
201	}

42		}
43	
44		// Archived memos are only visible to their creator.
45		if memo.RowStatus == store.Archived {
46			user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
47			if err != nil {
48				return status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
49			}
50			if user == nil || memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
51				return status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
52			}
53		}
54	
55		if memo.Visibility != store.Public {
56			user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
57			if err != nil {
58				return status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
59			}
60			if user == nil {
61				return status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
62			}
63			if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID {
64				return status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
65			}
66		}
67		return nil
68	}

19	// CreateMemoComment creates a comment on an existing memo.
20	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemoComment(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateMemoCommentRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
21		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
24		}
25		relatedMemo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
26		if err != nil {
27			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
28		}
29		if relatedMemo == nil {
30			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
31		}
32	
33		// Check memo visibility before allowing comment.
34		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
35		if err != nil {
36			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
37		}
38		if user == nil {
39			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
40		}
41		if relatedMemo.Visibility == store.Private && relatedMemo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
42			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
43		}
44		if request.Comment == nil {
45			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "comment is required")
46		}
47	
48		comment, ok := proto.Clone(request.Comment).(*v1pb.Memo)
49		if !ok {
50			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to clone memo comment")
51		}
52		comment.Visibility = convertVisibilityFromStore(relatedMemo.Visibility)
53	
54		// Create the memo comment first; suppress the generic memo.created SSE event
55		// since CreateMemoComment broadcasts memo.comment.created for the parent instead.
56		memoComment, err := s.CreateMemo(withSuppressMentionNotifications(withSuppressSSE(ctx)), &v1pb.CreateMemoRequest{
57			Memo:   comment,
58			MemoId: request.CommentId,
59		})
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo")
62		}
63		memoUID, err = ExtractMemoUIDFromName(memoComment.Name)
64		if err != nil {
65			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
66		}
67		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
70		}
71	
72		// Build the relation between the comment memo and the original memo.
73		_, err = s.Store.UpsertMemoRelation(ctx, &store.MemoRelation{
74			MemoID:        memo.ID,
75			RelatedMemoID: relatedMemo.ID,
76			Type:          store.MemoRelationComment,
77		})
78		if err != nil {
79			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo relation")
80		}
81	
82		// The comment memo was converted before the relation above existed, so its
83		// Relations slice is empty. Reload the relations now so that both the API
84		// response and the memo.comment.created webhook payload carry the relation
85		// to the parent memo.
86		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to load memo relations")
89		}
90		memoComment.Relations = relations
91	
92		creator, err := ResolveUserByName(ctx, s.Store, memoComment.Creator)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo creator")
95		}
96		if creator == nil {
97			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo creator not found")
98		}
99		creatorID := creator.ID
100		if memoComment.Visibility != v1pb.Visibility_PRIVATE && creatorID != relatedMemo.CreatorID {
101			if _, err := s.createInboxWithEmailNotification(ctx, &store.Inbox{
102				SenderID:   creatorID,
103				ReceiverID: relatedMemo.CreatorID,
104				Status:     store.UNREAD,
105				Message: &storepb.InboxMessage{
106					Type: storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_COMMENT,
107					Payload: &storepb.InboxMessage_MemoComment{
108						MemoComment: &storepb.InboxMessage_MemoCommentPayload{
109							MemoId:        memo.ID,
110							RelatedMemoId: relatedMemo.ID,
111						},
112					},
113				},
114			}); err != nil {
115				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create inbox")
116			}
117		}
118	
119		if err := s.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoComment, relatedMemo.CreatorID); err != nil {
120			slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo comment created webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
121		}
122	
123		s.dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort(ctx, memo, relatedMemo, "")
124	
125		// Broadcast live refresh event for the parent memo so subscribers see the new comment.
126		s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{
127			Type:       SSEEventMemoCommentCreated,
128			Name:       request.Name,
129			Visibility: relatedMemo.Visibility,
130			CreatorID:  relatedMemo.CreatorID,
131		})
132	
133		return memoComment, nil
134	}

136	func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemoComments(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListMemoCommentsRequest) (*v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse, error) {
137		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
138		if err != nil {
139			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
140		}
141		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
142		if err != nil {
143			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
144		}
145		if memo == nil {
146			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
147		}
148		if err := s.checkMemoReadAccess(ctx, memo); err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151	
152		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
153		if err != nil {
154			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
155		}
156		var memoFilter string
157		if currentUser == nil {
158			memoFilter = `visibility == "PUBLIC"`
159		} else {
160			memoFilter = fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
161		}
162		memoRelationComment := store.MemoRelationComment
163		var limit, offset int
164		if request.PageToken != "" {
165			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
166			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
167				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
168			}
169			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
170			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
171		} else {
172			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
173		}
174		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
175		memoRelations, err := s.Store.ListMemoRelations(ctx, &store.FindMemoRelation{
176			RelatedMemoID: &memo.ID,
177			Type:          &memoRelationComment,
178			MemoFilter:    &memoFilter,
179			Limit:         &limitPlusOne,
180			Offset:        &offset,
181		})
182		if err != nil {
183			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo relations")
184		}
185	
186		nextPageToken := ""
187		if len(memoRelations) == limitPlusOne {
188			memoRelations = memoRelations[:limit]
189			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
190			if err != nil {
191				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token, error: %v", err)
192			}
193		}
194	
195		if len(memoRelations) == 0 {
196			response := &v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse{
197				Memos:         []*v1pb.Memo{},
198				NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
199			}
200			return response, nil
201		}
202	
203		memoRelationIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memoRelations))
204		for _, m := range memoRelations {
205			memoRelationIDs = append(memoRelationIDs, m.MemoID)
206		}
207		memos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, &store.FindMemo{IDList: memoRelationIDs})
208		if err != nil {
209			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memos")
210		}
211	
212		memoIDToNameMap := make(map[int32]string)
213		contentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(memos))
214		memoIDsForAttachments := make([]int32, 0, len(memos))
215	
216		for _, memo := range memos {
217			memoName := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memo.UID)
218			memoIDToNameMap[memo.ID] = memoName
219			contentIDs = append(contentIDs, memoName)
220			memoIDsForAttachments = append(memoIDsForAttachments, memo.ID)
221		}
222		reactions, err := s.Store.ListReactions(ctx, &store.FindReaction{ContentIDList: contentIDs})
223		if err != nil {
224			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list reactions")
225		}
226	
227		memoReactionsMap := make(map[string][]*store.Reaction)
228		for _, reaction := range reactions {
229			memoReactionsMap[reaction.ContentID] = append(memoReactionsMap[reaction.ContentID], reaction)
230		}
231	
232		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{MemoIDList: memoIDsForAttachments})
233		if err != nil {
234			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")
235		}
236		attachmentMap := make(map[int32][]*store.Attachment)
237		for _, attachment := range attachments {
238			attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID] = append(attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID], attachment)
239		}
240	
241		// RELATIONS (batch load to avoid N+1)
242		relationMap, err := s.batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx, memos, false)
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to batch load memo relations")
245		}
246		creatorIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos)+len(reactions))
247		for _, memo := range memos {
248			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, memo.CreatorID)
249		}
250		for _, reaction := range reactions {
251			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, reaction.CreatorID)
252		}
253		creatorMap, err := s.listUsersByID(ctx, creatorIDs)
254		if err != nil {
255			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo creators: %v", err)
256		}
257		var memosResponse []*v1pb.Memo
258		for _, m := range memos {
259			memoName := memoIDToNameMap[m.ID]
260			reactions := memoReactionsMap[memoName]
261			attachments := attachmentMap[m.ID]
262			relations := relationMap[m.ID]
263

23	// SSEEvent represents a change event sent to SSE clients.
24	type SSEEvent struct {

26		// Name is the affected resource name (e.g., "memos/xxxx").

36	// JSON returns the JSON representation of the event.

54	// SSEHub manages SSE client connections and broadcasts events.

56	type SSEHub struct {
57		mu      sync.RWMutex
58		clients map[*SSEClient]struct{}
59		closed  bool
60	}

62	// NewSSEHub creates a new SSE hub.
63	func NewSSEHub() *SSEHub {
64		return &SSEHub{

66		}
67	}

69	// Subscribe registers a new client and returns it.
70	// The caller must call Unsubscribe when done.
71	func (h *SSEHub) Subscribe(userID int32, role store.Role) *SSEClient {
72		c := &SSEClient{
73			// Buffer a few events so a slow client doesn't block broadcasting.
74			events: make(chan []byte, 32),
75			userID: userID,
76			role:   role,
77		}
78		h.mu.Lock()
79		if h.closed {
80			close(c.events)
81		} else {
82			h.clients[c] = struct{}{}
83		}
84		h.mu.Unlock()
85		return c
86	}

88	// Unsubscribe removes a client and closes its channel.
89	func (h *SSEHub) Unsubscribe(c *SSEClient) {
90		h.mu.Lock()
91		if _, ok := h.clients[c]; ok {
92			delete(h.clients, c)
93			close(c.events)
94		}

96	}
97	
98	// Close disconnects all subscribed SSE clients.
99	func (h *SSEHub) Close() {

101		defer h.mu.Unlock()
102		if h.closed {
103			return

25	func RegisterSSERoutes(router sseRouteRegistrar, hub *SSEHub, storeInstance *store.Store, secret string) {

32	// handleSSE handles the SSE connection for live memo refresh.
33	// Authentication is done via Bearer token in the Authorization header.
34	func handleSSE(c *echo.Context, hub *SSEHub, authenticator *auth.Authenticator) error {
35		// Authenticate the request.
36		authHeader := c.Request().Header.Get("Authorization")

44		}

47		w := c.Response()
48		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")

54		// Flush headers immediately.
55		if f, ok := w.(http.Flusher); ok {
56			f.Flush()
57		}
58	
59		// Subscribe to the hub.
60		client := hub.Subscribe(userID, role)
61		defer hub.Unsubscribe(client)
62	
63		// Create a ticker for heartbeat pings.
64		heartbeat := time.NewTicker(sseHeartbeatInterval)
65		defer heartbeat.Stop()
66	
67		ctx := c.Request().Context()
68

72		// immediately instead of waiting for the first heartbeat or data event.
73		if _, err := fmt.Fprint(w, ": connected\n\n"); err != nil {

75		}
76		if f, ok := w.(http.Flusher); ok {

101	func (s *Server) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
102		var address, network string
103		if len(s.Profile.UNIXSock) == 0 {
104			address = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", s.Profile.Addr, s.Profile.Port)
105			network = "tcp"
106		} else {
107			address = s.Profile.UNIXSock
108			network = "unix"
109		}
110		listener, err := net.Listen(network, address)
111		if err != nil {
112			return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to listen")
113		}
114	
115		if network == "unix" {
116			if err := os.Chmod(address, 0660); err != nil {
117				_ = listener.Close()
118				return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to chmod socket")
119			}
120		}
121	
122		// Start Echo server directly (no cmux needed - all traffic is HTTP).
123		s.httpServer = &http.Server{Handler: s.echoServer}
124		go func() {
125			if err := s.httpServer.Serve(listener); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
126				slog.Error("failed to start echo server", "error", err)
127			}
128		}()
129		s.startBackgroundRunners(ctx)
130	
131		return nil
132	}

134	func (s *Server) Shutdown(ctx context.Context) {
135		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, shutdownTimeout)
136		defer cancel()

138		slog.Info("server shutting down")
139	
140		s.stopBackgroundRunners()
141		s.closeLongLivedConnections()

143		s.waitBackgroundRunners(ctx)

148		}

150		slog.Info("memos stopped properly")

153	func (s *Server) startBackgroundRunners(ctx context.Context) {
154		// Create a separate context for each background runner
155		// This allows us to control cancellation for each runner independently
156		s3Context, s3Cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
157	
158		// Store the cancel function so we can properly shut down runners
159		s.backgroundRunnerCancels = append(s.backgroundRunnerCancels, s3Cancel)
160	
161		// Create and start S3 presign runner
162		s3presignRunner := s3presign.NewRunner(s.Store)
163		s3presignRunner.RunOnce(ctx)
164	
165		// Start continuous S3 presign runner
166		s.backgroundRunnerWG.Add(1)
167		go func() {
168			defer s.backgroundRunnerWG.Done()
169			s3presignRunner.Run(s3Context)
170			slog.Info("s3presign runner stopped")
171		}()
172	
173		slog.Info("background runners started")
174	}

176	func (s *Server) stopBackgroundRunners() {
177		for _, cancelFunc := range s.backgroundRunnerCancels {
178			if cancelFunc != nil {
179				cancelFunc()
180			}
181		}
182	}

184	func (s *Server) waitBackgroundRunners(ctx context.Context) {
185		done := make(chan struct{})
186		go func() {
187			s.backgroundRunnerWG.Wait()
188			close(done)
189		}()
190	
191		select {
192		case <-done:
193		case <-ctx.Done():
194			select {
195			case <-done:
196				return
197			default:
198			}
199			slog.Error("failed to stop background runners", slog.String("error", ctx.Err().Error()))
200		}
201	}

204		// Long-lived SSE requests do not finish on their own during http.Server.Shutdown.
205		if s.sseHub != nil {

75				rpcMethod, ok := runtime.RPCMethod(ctx)

19	// CreateMemoComment creates a comment on an existing memo.
20	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemoComment(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateMemoCommentRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
21		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
24		}
25		relatedMemo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
26		if err != nil {
27			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
28		}
29		if relatedMemo == nil {
30			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
31		}
32	
33		// Check memo visibility before allowing comment.
34		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
35		if err != nil {
36			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
37		}
38		if user == nil {
39			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
40		}
41		if relatedMemo.Visibility == store.Private && relatedMemo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
42			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
43		}
44		if request.Comment == nil {
45			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "comment is required")
46		}
47	
48		comment, ok := proto.Clone(request.Comment).(*v1pb.Memo)
49		if !ok {
50			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to clone memo comment")
51		}
52		comment.Visibility = convertVisibilityFromStore(relatedMemo.Visibility)
53	
54		// Create the memo comment first; suppress the generic memo.created SSE event
55		// since CreateMemoComment broadcasts memo.comment.created for the parent instead.
56		memoComment, err := s.CreateMemo(withSuppressMentionNotifications(withSuppressSSE(ctx)), &v1pb.CreateMemoRequest{
57			Memo:   comment,
58			MemoId: request.CommentId,
59		})
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo")
62		}
63		memoUID, err = ExtractMemoUIDFromName(memoComment.Name)
64		if err != nil {
65			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
66		}
67		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
70		}
71	
72		// Build the relation between the comment memo and the original memo.
73		_, err = s.Store.UpsertMemoRelation(ctx, &store.MemoRelation{
74			MemoID:        memo.ID,
75			RelatedMemoID: relatedMemo.ID,
76			Type:          store.MemoRelationComment,
77		})
78		if err != nil {
79			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo relation")
80		}
81	
82		// The comment memo was converted before the relation above existed, so its
83		// Relations slice is empty. Reload the relations now so that both the API
84		// response and the memo.comment.created webhook payload carry the relation
85		// to the parent memo.
86		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to load memo relations")
89		}
90		memoComment.Relations = relations
91	
92		creator, err := ResolveUserByName(ctx, s.Store, memoComment.Creator)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo creator")
95		}
96		if creator == nil {
97			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo creator not found")
98		}
99		creatorID := creator.ID
100		if memoComment.Visibility != v1pb.Visibility_PRIVATE && creatorID != relatedMemo.CreatorID {
101			if _, err := s.createInboxWithEmailNotification(ctx, &store.Inbox{
102				SenderID:   creatorID,
103				ReceiverID: relatedMemo.CreatorID,
104				Status:     store.UNREAD,
105				Message: &storepb.InboxMessage{
106					Type: storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_COMMENT,
107					Payload: &storepb.InboxMessage_MemoComment{
108						MemoComment: &storepb.InboxMessage_MemoCommentPayload{
109							MemoId:        memo.ID,
110							RelatedMemoId: relatedMemo.ID,
111						},
112					},
113				},
114			}); err != nil {
115				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create inbox")
116			}
117		}
118	
119		if err := s.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoComment, relatedMemo.CreatorID); err != nil {
120			slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo comment created webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
121		}
122	
123		s.dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort(ctx, memo, relatedMemo, "")
124	
125		// Broadcast live refresh event for the parent memo so subscribers see the new comment.
126		s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{
127			Type:       SSEEventMemoCommentCreated,
128			Name:       request.Name,
129			Visibility: relatedMemo.Visibility,
130			CreatorID:  relatedMemo.CreatorID,
131		})
132	
133		return memoComment, nil
134	}

136	func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemoComments(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListMemoCommentsRequest) (*v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse, error) {
137		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
138		if err != nil {
139			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
140		}
141		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
142		if err != nil {
143			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
144		}
145		if memo == nil {
146			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
147		}
148		if err := s.checkMemoReadAccess(ctx, memo); err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}
151	
152		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
153		if err != nil {
154			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
155		}
156		var memoFilter string
157		if currentUser == nil {
158			memoFilter = `visibility == "PUBLIC"`
159		} else {
160			memoFilter = fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
161		}
162		memoRelationComment := store.MemoRelationComment
163		var limit, offset int
164		if request.PageToken != "" {
165			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
166			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
167				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
168			}
169			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
170			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
171		} else {
172			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
173		}
174		limitPlusOne := limit + 1
175		memoRelations, err := s.Store.ListMemoRelations(ctx, &store.FindMemoRelation{
176			RelatedMemoID: &memo.ID,
177			Type:          &memoRelationComment,
178			MemoFilter:    &memoFilter,
179			Limit:         &limitPlusOne,
180			Offset:        &offset,
181		})
182		if err != nil {
183			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo relations")
184		}
185	
186		nextPageToken := ""
187		if len(memoRelations) == limitPlusOne {
188			memoRelations = memoRelations[:limit]
189			nextPageToken, err = getPageToken(limit, offset+limit)
190			if err != nil {
191				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token, error: %v", err)
192			}
